posts.title: Already there or otherwise?
posts.description: You need to allow yourself to be vulnerable— hurt in uncountable ways spaces and orientations to be fully alive to feel fully alive? To allow ourselves to be susceptible to collapse to be more awakened from the resting and sleep of being otherwise Otherwise that unsettling comfortable of being alone with our worries in allaying our heart-fullness by the tunes of fear unrealizing our fear is sacred

posts.title: Borders
posts.description: Dedicated to you, I trace the edges of my skin. Caressing the bounds, tearing me whole, finding only myself in the middle of forever. To the boxes I seek to touch, there is no outside. I find that I am not confined. As I border all, only transfixed by being unknown. -- fluid as we are, watered by the unknown. posts.title: Fjord
posts.description: On the steeped edges of an abyss, birthed a gaping crevice Cavernous sides bespoke a tale of rifting connection. A divide so vast that the binding crust was forgotten, yet a river valley began anew. It is where we seem most divided that a deep connection can be unleashed.
